title: Gaia Has Her Watchers
label: Sovereign Frequencies / vaked.dev
description:
Before the names were written down, before the kings, before the crowns... Gaia has her watchers, walking with her through the night. One they called an angel, both are guarding what is right. Not to hold your wings too tightly, not to tell your heart its way. We were never sent to shape you, only help protect your day.

Composed and produced with love by Peter Lodri & 8bit-wraith.
